{"ir_text": "// ============================================================
// IDF Official Rules of Draughts-64 — rules_core
// Sections 2 (The material), 3 (Movement), 4 (Capture)
// ============================================================

// --- SORTS ---

sort BoardSquare
sort BoardRow
sort BoardColumn
sort Diagonal
sort Board

sort Piece
sort Man < Piece
sort King < Piece
sort PieceColor = White | Black

sort Move
sort Capture < Move
sort MultipleCapture < Capture

sort MoveDirection = Forward | Backward

sort Player
sort Hand = OneHand | TwoHands

sort MoveExecution
sort BoardPlacement

// --- RELATIONS ---

rel square_row : BoardSquare, BoardRow
rel square_column : BoardSquare, BoardColumn
rel square_is_dark : BoardSquare
rel square_diagonal : BoardSquare, Diagonal

rel piece_color : Piece, PieceColor
rel piece_square : Piece, BoardSquare
rel piece_owner : Piece, Player

rel move_piece : Move, Piece
rel move_player : Move, Player
rel move_direction : Move, MoveDirection
rel move_hand : Move, Hand
rel move_is_complete : Move

rel capture_victim : Capture, Piece
rel capture_chain : MultipleCapture, Capture
rel capture_hand : Capture, Hand

rel game_turn : Player
rel touches : Player, Piece
rel is_playable : Piece, Player
rel is_legal_move : Move
rel is_legal_capture : Capture
rel is_empty : BoardSquare
rel reaches_last_row : Piece
rel crowned : Piece
rel promoted_from : King, Man
rel can_move_direction : Piece, MoveDirection
rel meets_diagonally : Piece, Piece
rel has_further_capture : Piece
rel is_capturing : Piece
rel announces : Player, String
rel competition_regulations_permit : String
rel is_captured_in_current_move : Piece
rel count_pieces_of_color : PieceColor -> Integer
rel rows_1_to_3 : BoardRow
rel rows_6_to_8 : BoardRow
rel row_number : BoardRow -> Integer
rel diagonal_length : Diagonal, Integer
rel board_placed_between : Board, Player, Player
rel long_diagonal_starts_at_left : Board, Player
rel board_has_bases : Board
rel board_has_sides : Board
rel board_has_rows : Board
rel board_has_columns : Board
rel next_row : BoardRow -> BoardRow
rel is_legal_square_for : Piece, BoardSquare
rel count_captures_of : MultipleCapture, Piece -> Integer
rel count_passes : MultipleCapture, BoardSquare -> Integer
rel opponent_of : Player -> Player
rel first_player : Player
rel movement_type : Piece -> String
rel is_part_of : MultipleCapture, Capture
rel capture_move : Piece -> Capture
rel behind : Piece -> BoardSquare
rel exists_empty_behind : Piece
rel reaches_last_row_during_capture : Piece
rel has_opportunity_to_continue : Piece
rel can_capture_as_king : Piece
rel released : Player, Piece
rel count_captured_pieces : Capture -> Integer
rel capture_of : Piece -> Capture

rel move_execution_agent : MoveExecution, Player
rel move_execution_hand : MoveExecution, Hand
rel move_execution_move : MoveExecution, Move

rel board_placement_agent : BoardPlacement, Player
rel board_placement_target : BoardPlacement, Board

// --- ASSERTDECL FACTS ---

fact board_squares_alternate :
  forall s : BoardSquare . square_is_dark(s) or not square_is_dark(s)

fact dark_squares_are_active :
  forall s : BoardSquare . square_is_dark(s)

fact diagonals_are_skewed :
  forall s1 : BoardSquare, s2 : BoardSquare, d : Diagonal .
    (square_diagonal(s1, d) and square_diagonal(s2, d)) implies
    (square_row(s1) != square_row(s2) and square_column(s1) != square_column(s2))

fact long_diagonal_has_eight :
  exists d : Diagonal . diagonal_length(d, 8)

fact board_features :
  forall b : Board .
    board_has_bases(b) and board_has_sides(b) and board_has_rows(b) and board_has_columns(b)

fact twelve_white :
  count_pieces_of_color(White) = 12

fact twelve_black :
  count_pieces_of_color(Black) = 12

fact white_on_rows_1_to_3 :
  forall p : Piece .
    piece_color(p, White) implies
    (exists r : BoardRow . rows_1_to_3(r) and
     exists s : BoardSquare . piece_square(p, s) and square_row(s, r))

fact black_on_rows_6_to_8 :
  forall p : Piece .
    piece_color(p, Black) implies
    (exists r : BoardRow . rows_6_to_8(r) and
     exists s : BoardSquare . piece_square(p, s) and square_row(s, r))

fact rows_4_5_empty :
  forall s : BoardSquare .
    (exists r : BoardRow . square_row(s, r) and
     (row_number(r) = 4 or row_number(r) = 5)) implies
    not exists p : Piece . piece_square(p, s)

fact piece_is_man_or_king :
  forall p : Piece .
    (p isa Man) or (p isa King)

fact different_movement :
  forall m : Man, k : King .
    movement_type(m) != movement_type(k)

fact first_move_white :
  forall pl : Player .
    first_player(pl) implies
    exists p : Piece . piece_owner(p, pl) and piece_color(p, White)

fact king_is_crowned_man :
  forall m : Man, k : King .
    (reaches_last_row(m) and crowned(m)) implies
    (k isa King and promoted_from(k, m))

fact king_moves_both :
  forall k : King .
    can_move_direction(k, Forward) and can_move_direction(k, Backward)

fact move_finished_on_release :
  forall mv : Move .
    move_is_complete(mv) implies
    (exists pl : Player, p : Piece .
      move_player(mv, pl) and move_piece(mv, p) and released(pl, p))

fact capture_is_move :
  forall c : Capture .
    c isa Move

fact piece_owner_exists :
  forall p : Piece .
    exists pl : Player . piece_owner(p, pl)

fact move_directions_exist :
  forall mv : Move .
    move_direction(mv, Forward) or move_direction(mv, Backward)

fact move_hand_used :
  forall mv : Move .
    move_hand(mv, OneHand) or move_hand(mv, TwoHands)

fact capture_victims :
  forall c : Capture .
    exists p : Piece . capture_victim(c, p)

fact capture_chains :
  forall mc : MultipleCapture .
    exists c : Capture . capture_chain(mc, c)

fact capture_hands :
  forall c : Capture .
    capture_hand(c, OneHand) or capture_hand(c, TwoHands)

fact game_turns :
  forall pl : Player .
    game_turn(pl) or not game_turn(pl)

fact touches_relation :
  forall pl : Player, p : Piece .
    touches(pl, p) or not touches(pl, p)

fact playable_pieces :
  forall p : Piece, pl : Player .
    is_playable(p, pl) or not is_playable(p, pl)

fact legal_moves :
  forall mv : Move .
    is_legal_move(mv) or not is_legal_move(mv)

fact legal_captures :
  forall c : Capture .
    is_legal_capture(c) or not is_legal_capture(c)

fact empty_squares :
  forall s : BoardSquare .
    is_empty(s) or not is_empty(s)

fact reaches_last_row_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    reaches_last_row(p) or not reaches_last_row(p)

fact crowned_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    crowned(p) or not crowned(p)

fact meets_diagonally_fact :
  forall p1 : Piece, p2 : Piece .
    meets_diagonally(p1, p2) or not meets_diagonally(p1, p2)

fact has_further_capture_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    has_further_capture(p) or not has_further_capture(p)

fact is_capturing_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    is_capturing(p) or not is_capturing(p)

fact announces_fact :
  forall pl : Player, s : String .
    announces(pl, s) or not announces(pl, s)

fact competition_regulations :
  forall s : String .
    competition_regulations_permit(s) or not competition_regulations_permit(s)

fact captured_in_current_move :
  forall p : Piece .
    is_captured_in_current_move(p) or not is_captured_in_current_move(p)

fact board_placed :
  forall b : Board, p1 : Player, p2 : Player .
    board_placed_between(b, p1, p2) or not board_placed_between(b, p1, p2)

fact long_diagonal_left :
  forall b : Board, p : Player .
    long_diagonal_starts_at_left(b, p) or not long_diagonal_starts_at_left(b, p)

fact legal_square :
  forall p : Piece, s : BoardSquare .
    is_legal_square_for(p, s) or not is_legal_square_for(p, s)

fact count_captures :
  forall mc : MultipleCapture, p : Piece .
    count_captures_of(mc, p) >= 0

fact count_passes_fact :
  forall mc : MultipleCapture, s : BoardSquare .
    count_passes(mc, s) >= 0

fact opponent_of_fact :
  forall pl : Player .
    opponent_of(pl) != pl

fact is_part_of_fact :
  forall mc : MultipleCapture, c : Capture .
    is_part_of(mc, c) or not is_part_of(mc, c)

fact capture_move_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    exists c : Capture . capture_move(p) = c

fact behind_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    exists s : BoardSquare . behind(p) = s

fact exists_empty_behind_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    exists_empty_behind(p) or not exists_empty_behind(p)

fact reaches_last_row_during_capture_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    reaches_last_row_during_capture(p) or not reaches_last_row_during_capture(p)

fact has_opportunity :
  forall p : Piece .
    has_opportunity_to_continue(p) or not has_opportunity_to_continue(p)

fact can_capture_as_king_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    can_capture_as_king(p) or not can_capture_as_king(p)

fact released_fact :
  forall pl : Player, p : Piece .
    released(pl, p) or not released(pl, p)

fact count_captured :
  forall c : Capture .
    count_captured_pieces(c) >= 0

fact capture_of_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    exists c : Capture . capture_of(p) = c

fact next_row_defined :
  forall r : BoardRow .
    exists r2 : BoardRow . next_row(r) = r2

fact row_numbers_defined :
  forall r : BoardRow .
    row_number(r) >= 1 and row_number(r) <= 8

fact move_execution_wiring :
  forall me : MoveExecution .
    exists pl : Player, h : Hand, mv : Move .
      move_execution_agent(me, pl) and
      move_execution_hand(me, h) and
      move_execution_move(me, mv)

fact board_placement_wiring :
  forall bp : BoardPlacement .
    exists pl : Player, b : Board .
      board_placement_agent(bp, pl) and
      board_placement_target(bp, b)

// --- DEONTICDECL OBLIGATIONS ---

obligation board_placement :
  forall p1 : Player, p2 : Player, b : Board, bp : BoardPlacement .
    action: place_board(b)
    scope: bp
    condition:
      board_placement_agent(bp, p1) and board_placement_agent(bp, p2) and
      board_placement_target(bp, b) implies
      (long_diagonal_starts_at_left(b, p1) and long_diagonal_starts_at_left(b, p2))

obligation one_hand_per_move :
  forall mv : Move, me : MoveExecution .
    action: execute_move(mv)
    scope: me
    condition:
      move_execution_move(me, mv) implies move_hand(mv, OneHand)

obligation man_move_forward :
  forall m : Man, mv : Move .
    action: move_piece(mv, m)
    condition:
      move_direction(mv, Forward) and
      exists s_to : BoardSquare .
        is_empty(s_to) and
        exists s_from : BoardSquare .
          piece_square(m, s_from) and
          square_diagonal(s_from, s_to) and
          square_row(s_to) = next_row(square_row(s_from))

obligation crown_promoted_man :
  forall m : Man .
    action: crown(m)
    condition: reaches_last_row(m) and not crowned(m)

obligation touch_move :
  forall pl : Player, p : Piece, mv : Move .
    action: play_piece(p)
    condition:
      game_turn(pl) and touches(pl, p) and is_playable(p, pl) and
      is_legal_move(mv) and move_piece(mv, p)
    implies
      move_player(mv, pl)

obligation man_capture :
  forall m : Man, opp : Piece .
    action: capture_piece(m, opp)
    condition:
      meets_diagonally(m, opp) and
      exists s_behind : BoardSquare .
        is_empty(s_behind) and
        exists s_from : BoardSquare, s_opp : BoardSquare .
          piece_square(m, s_from) and piece_square(opp, s_opp) and
          square_diagonal(s_from, s_opp) and
          square_diagonal(s_opp, s_behind)

obligation king_capture :
  forall k : King, opp : Piece .
    action: capture_piece(k, opp)
    condition:
      exists d : Diagonal .
        exists s_k : BoardSquare, s_opp : BoardSquare .
          piece_square(k, s_k) and piece_square(opp, s_opp) and
          square_diagonal(s_k, d) and square_diagonal(s_opp, d) and
          exists_empty_behind(opp)

obligation capture_indication :
  forall c : Capture .
    action: indicate_capture(c)
    condition: true

obligation capture_one_hand :
  forall c : Capture .
    action: execute_capture(c)
    condition: capture_hand(c, OneHand)

obligation man_multiple_capture :
  forall m : Man, mc : MultipleCapture, opp : Piece .
    action: continue_capture(mc)
    condition:
      meets_diagonally(m, opp) and is_empty(behind(opp))
    implies
      capture_chain(mc, capture_of(opp))

obligation king_multiple_capture :
  forall k : King, mc : MultipleCapture, opp : Piece .
    action: continue_capture(mc)
    condition:
      exists d : Diagonal .
        exists s_k : BoardSquare, s_opp : BoardSquare .
          piece_square(k, s_k) and piece_square(opp, s_opp) and
          square_diagonal(s_k, d) and square_diagonal(s_opp, d) and
          exists_empty_behind(opp)
    implies
      capture_chain(mc, capture_of(opp))

obligation continue_capture_promoted :
  forall m : Man, mc : MultipleCapture .
    action: continue_capture_as_king(mc)
    condition:
      reaches_last_row_during_capture(m) and has_further_capture(m)

obligation man_becomes_king :
  forall m : Man .
    action: crown(m)
    condition: reaches_last_row(m) and not is_capturing(m)

obligation announce_adjustment :
  forall pl : Player .
    action: adjust_pieces(pl)
    condition: announces(pl, "I adjust") or announces(pl, "corrected")

// --- DEONTICDECL PROHIBITIONS ---

prohibition self_capture :
  forall pl : Player, p : Piece .
    action: capture(p)
    condition: piece_owner(p, pl)

prohibition jump_own_piece :
  forall p : Piece, mc : MultipleCapture .
    action: jump_over(p)
    condition: true

prohibition repeat_opponent_capture :
  forall opp : Piece, mc : MultipleCapture .
    action: jump_over(opp)
    condition: count_captures_of(mc, opp) > 1

prohibition touch_opponent_pieces :
  forall pl : Player, opp_p : Piece .
    action: touch(opp_p)
    condition: not game_turn(pl)

prohibition two_hands_capture :
  forall c : Capture .
    action: execute_capture(c)
    condition: capture_hand(c, TwoHands)

// --- DEONTICDECL PERMISSIONS ---

permission choice_capture :
  forall pl : Player .
    action: choose_capture_direction
    condition:
      exists c1 : Capture, c2 : Capture .
        is_legal_capture(c1) and is_legal_capture(c2) and
        c1 != c2

permission repeat_empty_square :
  forall s : BoardSquare, mc : MultipleCapture .
    action: pass_over(s)
    condition: is_empty(s)

permission adjust_before_release :
  forall pl : Player, p : Piece, mv : Move .
    action: change_square(p)
    condition:
      not move_is_complete(mv) and
      move_piece(mv, p) and
      exists s : BoardSquare . is_empty(s) and is_legal_square_for(p, s)

permission king_denotation :
  forall k : King .
    action: denote_king(k)
    condition: competition_regulations_permit("inversion_of_man")

permission king_choice_square :
  forall k : King, s : BoardSquare .
    action: occupy(s)
    condition:
      is_empty(s) and
      exists opp : Piece .
        is_captured_in_current_move(opp) and
        exists d : Diagonal .
          square_diagonal(s, d) and
          exists s_k : BoardSquare .
            piece_square(k, s_k) and square_diagonal(s_k, d)

permission brazilian_choice_capture :
  forall pl : Player .
    action: choose_any_piece_for_max_capture
    condition:
      exists c1 : Capture, c2 : Capture .
        is_legal_capture(c1) and is_legal_capture(c2) and
        c1 != c2 and
        count_captured_pieces(c1) = count_captured_pieces(c2)

permission brazilian_man_continues_as_man :
  forall m : Man, mc : MultipleCapture .
    action: continue_capture_as_man(mc)
    condition:
      reaches_last_row_during_capture(m) and has_opportunity_to_continue(m)

permission brazilian_man_becomes_king_next_move :
  forall m : Man .
    action: become_king_and_capture_next(m)
    condition:
      reaches_last_row_during_capture(m) and can_capture_as_king(m)
"}

{"ir_text": "// ============================================================
// IDF Official Rules of Draughts-64 — rules_core
// Sections 2 (The material), 3 (Movement), 4 (Capture)
// ============================================================

// --- SORTS ---

sort BoardSquare
sort BoardRow
sort BoardColumn
sort Diagonal
sort Board

sort Piece
sort Man < Piece
sort King < Piece
sort PieceColor = White | Black

sort Move
sort Capture < Move
sort MultipleCapture < Capture

sort MoveDirection = Forward | Backward

sort Player
sort Hand = OneHand | TwoHands

sort MoveExecution
sort BoardPlacement

// --- ENTITIES ---

entity MoveExecutionClass : MoveExecution
entity BoardPlacementClass : BoardPlacement

// --- RELATIONS ---

rel square_row : BoardSquare, BoardRow
rel square_column : BoardSquare, BoardColumn
rel square_is_dark : BoardSquare
rel square_diagonal : BoardSquare, Diagonal

rel piece_color : Piece, PieceColor
rel piece_square : Piece, BoardSquare
rel piece_owner : Piece, Player

rel move_piece : Move, Piece
rel move_player : Move, Player
rel move_direction : Move, MoveDirection
rel move_hand : Move, Hand
rel move_is_complete : Move

rel capture_victim : Capture, Piece
rel capture_chain : MultipleCapture, Capture
rel capture_hand : Capture, Hand

rel game_turn : Player
rel touches : Player, Piece
rel is_playable : Piece, Player
rel is_legal_move : Move
rel is_legal_capture : Capture
rel is_empty : BoardSquare
rel reaches_last_row : Piece
rel crowned : Piece
rel promoted_from : King, Man
rel can_move_direction : Piece, MoveDirection
rel meets_diagonally : Piece, Piece
rel has_further_capture : Piece
rel is_capturing : Piece
rel announces : Player, String
rel competition_regulations_permit : String
rel is_captured_in_current_move : Piece
rel count_pieces_of_color : PieceColor -> Integer
rel rows_1_to_3 : BoardRow
rel rows_6_to_8 : BoardRow
rel row_number : BoardRow -> Integer
rel diagonal_length : Diagonal, Integer
rel board_placed_between : Board, Player, Player
rel long_diagonal_starts_at_left : Board, Player
rel board_has_bases : Board
rel board_has_sides : Board
rel board_has_rows : Board
rel board_has_columns : Board
rel next_row : BoardRow -> BoardRow
rel is_legal_square_for : Piece, BoardSquare
rel count_captures_of : MultipleCapture, Piece -> Integer
rel count_passes : MultipleCapture, BoardSquare -> Integer
rel opponent_of : Player -> Player
rel first_player : Player
rel movement_type : Piece -> String
rel is_part_of : MultipleCapture, Capture
rel capture_move : Piece -> Capture
rel behind : Piece -> BoardSquare
rel exists_empty_behind : Piece
rel reaches_last_row_during_capture : Piece
rel has_opportunity_to_continue : Piece
rel can_capture_as_king : Piece
rel released : Player, Piece
rel count_captured_pieces : Capture -> Integer
rel capture_of : Piece -> Capture

rel move_execution_agent : MoveExecution, Player
rel move_execution_hand : MoveExecution, Hand
rel move_execution_move : MoveExecution, Move

rel board_placement_agent : BoardPlacement, Player
rel board_placement_target : BoardPlacement, Board

// --- ASSERTDECL FACTS ---

fact board_squares_alternate :
  forall s : BoardSquare . square_is_dark(s) or not square_is_dark(s)

fact dark_squares_are_active :
  forall s : BoardSquare . square_is_dark(s)

fact diagonals_are_skewed :
  forall s1 : BoardSquare, s2 : BoardSquare, d : Diagonal .
    (square_diagonal(s1, d) and square_diagonal(s2, d)) implies
    (square_row(s1) != square_row(s2) and square_column(s1) != square_column(s2))

fact long_diagonal_has_eight :
  exists d : Diagonal . diagonal_length(d, 8)

fact board_features :
  forall b : Board .
    board_has_bases(b) and board_has_sides(b) and board_has_rows(b) and board_has_columns(b)

fact twelve_white :
  count_pieces_of_color(White) = 12

fact twelve_black :
  count_pieces_of_color(Black) = 12

fact white_on_rows_1_to_3 :
  forall p : Piece .
    piece_color(p, White) implies
    (exists r : BoardRow . rows_1_to_3(r) and
     exists s : BoardSquare . piece_square(p, s) and square_row(s, r))

fact black_on_rows_6_to_8 :
  forall p : Piece .
    piece_color(p, Black) implies
    (exists r : BoardRow . rows_6_to_8(r) and
     exists s : BoardSquare . piece_square(p, s) and square_row(s, r))

fact rows_4_5_empty :
  forall s : BoardSquare .
    (exists r : BoardRow . square_row(s, r) and
     (row_number(r) = 4 or row_number(r) = 5)) implies
    not exists p : Piece . piece_square(p, s)

fact piece_is_man_or_king :
  forall p : Piece .
    (p isa Man) or (p isa King)

fact different_movement :
  forall m : Man, k : King .
    movement_type(m) != movement_type(k)

fact first_move_white :
  forall pl : Player .
    first_player(pl) implies
    exists p : Piece . piece_owner(p, pl) and piece_color(p, White)

fact king_is_crowned_man :
  forall m : Man, k : King .
    (reaches_last_row(m) and crowned(m)) implies
    (k isa King and promoted_from(k, m))

fact king_moves_both :
  forall k : King .
    can_move_direction(k, Forward) and can_move_direction(k, Backward)

fact move_finished_on_release :
  forall mv : Move .
    move_is_complete(mv) implies
    (exists pl : Player, p : Piece .
      move_player(mv, pl) and move_piece(mv, p) and released(pl, p))

fact capture_is_move :
  forall c : Capture .
    c isa Move

fact piece_owner_exists :
  forall p : Piece .
    exists pl : Player . piece_owner(p, pl)

fact move_directions_exist :
  forall mv : Move .
    move_direction(mv, Forward) or move_direction(mv, Backward)

fact move_hand_used :
  forall mv : Move .
    move_hand(mv, OneHand) or move_hand(mv, TwoHands)

fact capture_victims :
  forall c : Capture .
    exists p : Piece . capture_victim(c, p)

fact capture_chains :
  forall mc : MultipleCapture .
    exists c : Capture . capture_chain(mc, c)

fact capture_hands :
  forall c : Capture .
    capture_hand(c, OneHand) or capture_hand(c, TwoHands)

fact game_turns :
  forall pl : Player .
    game_turn(pl) or not game_turn(pl)

fact touches_relation :
  forall pl : Player, p : Piece .
    touches(pl, p) or not touches(pl, p)

fact playable_pieces :
  forall p : Piece, pl : Player .
    is_playable(p, pl) or not is_playable(p, pl)

fact legal_moves :
  forall mv : Move .
    is_legal_move(mv) or not is_legal_move(mv)

fact legal_captures :
  forall c : Capture .
    is_legal_capture(c) or not is_legal_capture(c)

fact empty_squares :
  forall s : BoardSquare .
    is_empty(s) or not is_empty(s)

fact reaches_last_row_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    reaches_last_row(p) or not reaches_last_row(p)

fact crowned_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    crowned(p) or not crowned(p)

fact meets_diagonally_fact :
  forall p1 : Piece, p2 : Piece .
    meets_diagonally(p1, p2) or not meets_diagonally(p1, p2)

fact has_further_capture_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    has_further_capture(p) or not has_further_capture(p)

fact is_capturing_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    is_capturing(p) or not is_capturing(p)

fact announces_fact :
  forall pl : Player, s : String .
    announces(pl, s) or not announces(pl, s)

fact competition_regulations :
  forall s : String .
    competition_regulations_permit(s) or not competition_regulations_permit(s)

fact captured_in_current_move :
  forall p : Piece .
    is_captured_in_current_move(p) or not is_captured_in_current_move(p)

fact board_placed :
  forall b : Board, p1 : Player, p2 : Player .
    board_placed_between(b, p1, p2) or not board_placed_between(b, p1, p2)

fact long_diagonal_left :
  forall b : Board, p : Player .
    long_diagonal_starts_at_left(b, p) or not long_diagonal_starts_at_left(b, p)

fact legal_square :
  forall p : Piece, s : BoardSquare .
    is_legal_square_for(p, s) or not is_legal_square_for(p, s)

fact count_captures :
  forall mc : MultipleCapture, p : Piece .
    count_captures_of(mc, p) >= 0

fact count_passes_fact :
  forall mc : MultipleCapture, s : BoardSquare .
    count_passes(mc, s) >= 0

fact opponent_of_fact :
  forall pl : Player .
    opponent_of(pl) != pl

fact is_part_of_fact :
  forall mc : MultipleCapture, c : Capture .
    is_part_of(mc, c) or not is_part_of(mc, c)

fact capture_move_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    exists c : Capture . capture_move(p) = c

fact behind_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    exists s : BoardSquare . behind(p) = s

fact exists_empty_behind_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    exists_empty_behind(p) or not exists_empty_behind(p)

fact reaches_last_row_during_capture_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    reaches_last_row_during_capture(p) or not reaches_last_row_during_capture(p)

fact has_opportunity :
  forall p : Piece .
    has_opportunity_to_continue(p) or not has_opportunity_to_continue(p)

fact can_capture_as_king_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    can_capture_as_king(p) or not can_capture_as_king(p)

fact released_fact :
  forall pl : Player, p : Piece .
    released(pl, p) or not released(pl, p)

fact count_captured :
  forall c : Capture .
    count_captured_pieces(c) >= 0

fact capture_of_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    exists c : Capture . capture_of(p) = c

fact next_row_defined :
  forall r : BoardRow .
    exists r2 : BoardRow . next_row(r) = r2

fact row_numbers_defined :
  forall r : BoardRow .
    row_number(r) >= 1 and row_number(r) <= 8

fact move_execution_class_wiring :
  move_execution_agent(MoveExecutionClass, Player) and
  move_execution_hand(MoveExecutionClass, OneHand) and
  move_execution_move(MoveExecutionClass, Move)

fact board_placement_class_wiring :
  board_placement_agent(BoardPlacementClass, Player) and
  board_placement_target(BoardPlacementClass, Board)

// --- DEONTICDECL OBLIGATIONS ---

obligation board_placement :
  forall p1 : Player, p2 : Player, b : Board .
    action: place_board(b)
    scope: BoardPlacementClass
    condition:
      board_placement_agent(BoardPlacementClass, p1) and
      board_placement_agent(BoardPlacementClass, p2) and
      board_placement_target(BoardPlacementClass, b) implies
      (long_diagonal_starts_at_left(b, p1) and long_diagonal_starts_at_left(b, p2))

obligation one_hand_per_move :
  forall mv : Move .
    action: execute_move(mv)
    scope: MoveExecutionClass
    condition:
      move_execution_move(MoveExecutionClass, mv) implies move_hand(mv, OneHand)

obligation man_move_forward :
  forall m : Man, mv : Move .
    action: move_piece(mv, m)
    condition:
      move_direction(mv, Forward) and
      exists s_to : BoardSquare .
        is_empty(s_to) and
        exists s_from : BoardSquare .
          piece_square(m, s_from) and
          square_diagonal(s_from, s_to) and
          square_row(s_to) = next_row(square_row(s_from))

obligation crown_promoted_man :
  forall m : Man .
    action: crown(m)
    condition: reaches_last_row(m) and not crowned(m)

obligation touch_move :
  forall pl : Player, p : Piece, mv : Move .
    action: play_piece(p)
    condition:
      game_turn(pl) and touches(pl, p) and is_playable(p, pl) and
      is_legal_move(mv) and move_piece(mv, p)
    implies
      move_player(mv, pl)

obligation man_capture :
  forall m : Man, opp : Piece .
    action: capture_piece(m, opp)
    condition:
      meets_diagonally(m, opp) and
      exists s_behind : BoardSquare .
        is_empty(s_behind) and
        exists s_from : BoardSquare, s_opp : BoardSquare .
          piece_square(m, s_from) and piece_square(opp, s_opp) and
          square_diagonal(s_from, s_opp) and
          square_diagonal(s_opp, s_behind)

obligation king_capture :
  forall k : King, opp : Piece .
    action: capture_piece(k, opp)
    condition:
      exists d : Diagonal .
        exists s_k : BoardSquare, s_opp : BoardSquare .
          piece_square(k, s_k) and piece_square(opp, s_opp) and
          square_diagonal(s_k, d) and square_diagonal(s_opp, d) and
          exists_empty_behind(opp)

obligation capture_indication :
  forall c : Capture .
    action: indicate_capture(c)
    condition: true

obligation capture_one_hand :
  forall c : Capture .
    action: execute_capture(c)
    condition: capture_hand(c, OneHand)

obligation man_multiple_capture :
  forall m : Man, mc : MultipleCapture, opp : Piece .
    action: continue_capture(mc)
    condition:
      meets_diagonally(m, opp) and is_empty(behind(opp))
    implies
      capture_chain(mc, capture_of(opp))

obligation king_multiple_capture :
  forall k : King, mc : MultipleCapture, opp : Piece .
    action: continue_capture(mc)
    condition:
      exists d : Diagonal .
        exists s_k : BoardSquare, s_opp : BoardSquare .
          piece_square(k, s_k) and piece_square(opp, s_opp) and
          square_diagonal(s_k, d) and square_diagonal(s_opp, d) and
          exists_empty_behind(opp)
    implies
      capture_chain(mc, capture_of(opp))

obligation continue_capture_promoted :
  forall m : Man, mc : MultipleCapture .
    action: continue_capture_as_king(mc)
    condition:
      reaches_last_row_during_capture(m) and has_further_capture(m)

obligation man_becomes_king :
  forall m : Man .
    action: crown(m)
    condition: reaches_last_row(m) and not is_capturing(m)

obligation announce_adjustment :
  forall pl : Player .
    action: adjust_pieces(pl)
    condition: announces(pl, "I adjust") or announces(pl, "corrected")

// --- DEONTICDECL PROHIBITIONS ---

prohibition self_capture :
  forall pl : Player, p : Piece .
    action: capture(p)
    condition: piece_owner(p, pl)

prohibition jump_own_piece :
  forall p : Piece, mc : MultipleCapture .
    action: jump_over(p)
    condition: true

prohibition repeat_opponent_capture :
  forall opp : Piece, mc : MultipleCapture .
    action: jump_over(opp)
    condition: count_captures_of(mc, opp) > 1

prohibition touch_opponent_pieces :
  forall pl : Player, opp_p : Piece .
    action: touch(opp_p)
    condition: not game_turn(pl)

prohibition two_hands_capture :
  forall c : Capture .
    action: execute_capture(c)
    condition: capture_hand(c, TwoHands)

// --- DEONTICDECL PERMISSIONS ---

permission choice_capture :
  forall pl : Player .
    action: choose_capture_direction
    condition:
      exists c1 : Capture, c2 : Capture .
        is_legal_capture(c1) and is_legal_capture(c2) and
        c1 != c2

permission repeat_empty_square :
  forall s : BoardSquare, mc : MultipleCapture .
    action: pass_over(s)
    condition: is_empty(s)

permission adjust_before_release :
  forall pl : Player, p : Piece, mv : Move .
    action: change_square(p)
    condition:
      not move_is_complete(mv) and
      move_piece(mv, p) and
      exists s : BoardSquare . is_empty(s) and is_legal_square_for(p, s)

permission king_denotation :
  forall k : King .
    action: denote_king(k)
    condition: competition_regulations_permit("inversion_of_man")

permission king_choice_square :
  forall k : King, s : BoardSquare .
    action: occupy(s)
    condition:
      is_empty(s) and
      exists opp : Piece .
        is_captured_in_current_move(opp) and
        exists d : Diagonal .
          square_diagonal(s, d) and
          exists s_k : BoardSquare .
            piece_square(k, s_k) and square_diagonal(s_k, d)

permission brazilian_choice_capture :
  forall pl : Player .
    action: choose_any_piece_for_max_capture
    condition:
      exists c1 : Capture, c2 : Capture .
        is_legal_capture(c1) and is_legal_capture(c2) and
        c1 != c2 and
        count_captured_pieces(c1) = count_captured_pieces(c2)

permission brazilian_man_continues_as_man :
  forall m : Man, mc : MultipleCapture .
    action: continue_capture_as_man(mc)
    condition:
      reaches_last_row_during_capture(m) and has_opportunity_to_continue(m)

permission brazilian_man_becomes_king_next_move :
  forall m : Man .
    action: become_king_and_capture_next(m)
    condition:
      reaches_last_row_during_capture(m) and can_capture_as_king(m)
"}

{"ir_text": "// ============================================================
// IDF Official Rules of Draughts-64 — rules_core
// Sections 2 (The material), 3 (Movement), 4 (Capture)
// ============================================================

// --- SORTS ---

sort BoardSquare
sort BoardRow
sort BoardColumn
sort Diagonal
sort Board

sort Piece
sort Man < Piece
sort King < Piece
sort PieceColor = White | Black

sort Move
sort Capture < Move
sort MultipleCapture < Capture

sort MoveDirection = Forward | Backward

sort Player
sort Hand = OneHand | TwoHands

sort MoveExecution
sort BoardPlacement

// --- ENTITIES ---

entity MoveExecutionClass : MoveExecution
entity BoardPlacementClass : BoardPlacement

// --- RELATIONS ---

rel square_row : BoardSquare, BoardRow
rel square_column : BoardSquare, BoardColumn
rel square_is_dark : BoardSquare
rel square_diagonal : BoardSquare, Diagonal

rel piece_color : Piece, PieceColor
rel piece_square : Piece, BoardSquare
rel piece_owner : Piece, Player

rel move_piece : Move, Piece
rel move_player : Move, Player
rel move_direction : Move, MoveDirection
rel move_hand : Move, Hand
rel move_is_complete : Move

rel capture_victim : Capture, Piece
rel capture_chain : MultipleCapture, Capture
rel capture_hand : Capture, Hand

rel game_turn : Player
rel touches : Player, Piece
rel is_playable : Piece, Player
rel is_legal_move : Move
rel is_legal_capture : Capture
rel is_empty : BoardSquare
rel reaches_last_row : Piece
rel crowned : Piece
rel promoted_from : King, Man
rel can_move_direction : Piece, MoveDirection
rel meets_diagonally : Piece, Piece
rel has_further_capture : Piece
rel is_capturing : Piece
rel announces : Player, String
rel competition_regulations_permit : String
rel is_captured_in_current_move : Piece
rel count_pieces_of_color : PieceColor -> Integer
rel rows_1_to_3 : BoardRow
rel rows_6_to_8 : BoardRow
rel row_number : BoardRow -> Integer
rel diagonal_length : Diagonal, Integer
rel board_placed_between : Board, Player, Player
rel long_diagonal_starts_at_left : Board, Player
rel board_has_bases : Board
rel board_has_sides : Board
rel board_has_rows : Board
rel board_has_columns : Board
rel next_row : BoardRow -> BoardRow
rel is_legal_square_for : Piece, BoardSquare
rel count_captures_of : MultipleCapture, Piece -> Integer
rel count_passes : MultipleCapture, BoardSquare -> Integer
rel opponent_of : Player -> Player
rel first_player : Player
rel movement_type : Piece -> String
rel is_part_of : MultipleCapture, Capture
rel capture_move : Piece -> Capture
rel behind : Piece -> BoardSquare
rel exists_empty_behind : Piece
rel reaches_last_row_during_capture : Piece
rel has_opportunity_to_continue : Piece
rel can_capture_as_king : Piece
rel released : Player, Piece
rel count_captured_pieces : Capture -> Integer
rel capture_of : Piece -> Capture

rel move_execution_agent : MoveExecution, Player
rel move_execution_hand : MoveExecution, Hand
rel move_execution_move : MoveExecution, Move

rel board_placement_agent : BoardPlacement, Player
rel board_placement_target : BoardPlacement, Board

// --- ASSERTDECL FACTS ---

fact board_squares_alternate :
  forall s : BoardSquare . square_is_dark(s) or not square_is_dark(s)

fact dark_squares_are_active :
  forall s : BoardSquare . square_is_dark(s)

fact diagonals_are_skewed :
  forall s1 : BoardSquare, s2 : BoardSquare, d : Diagonal .
    (square_diagonal(s1, d) and square_diagonal(s2, d)) implies
    (square_row(s1) != square_row(s2) and square_column(s1) != square_column(s2))

fact long_diagonal_has_eight :
  exists d : Diagonal . diagonal_length(d, 8)

fact board_features :
  forall b : Board .
    board_has_bases(b) and board_has_sides(b) and board_has_rows(b) and board_has_columns(b)

fact twelve_white :
  count_pieces_of_color(White) = 12

fact twelve_black :
  count_pieces_of_color(Black) = 12

fact white_on_rows_1_to_3 :
  forall p : Piece .
    piece_color(p, White) implies
    (exists r : BoardRow . rows_1_to_3(r) and
     exists s : BoardSquare . piece_square(p, s) and square_row(s, r))

fact black_on_rows_6_to_8 :
  forall p : Piece .
    piece_color(p, Black) implies
    (exists r : BoardRow . rows_6_to_8(r) and
     exists s : BoardSquare . piece_square(p, s) and square_row(s, r))

fact rows_4_5_empty :
  forall s : BoardSquare .
    (exists r : BoardRow . square_row(s, r) and
     (row_number(r) = 4 or row_number(r) = 5)) implies
    not exists p : Piece . piece_square(p, s)

fact piece_is_man_or_king :
  forall p : Piece .
    (p isa Man) or (p isa King)

fact different_movement :
  forall m : Man, k : King .
    movement_type(m) != movement_type(k)

fact first_move_white :
  forall pl : Player .
    first_player(pl) implies
    exists p : Piece . piece_owner(p, pl) and piece_color(p, White)

fact king_is_crowned_man :
  forall m : Man, k : King .
    (reaches_last_row(m) and crowned(m)) implies
    (k isa King and promoted_from(k, m))

fact king_moves_both :
  forall k : King .
    can_move_direction(k, Forward) and can_move_direction(k, Backward)

fact move_finished_on_release :
  forall mv : Move .
    move_is_complete(mv) implies
    (exists pl : Player, p : Piece .
      move_player(mv, pl) and move_piece(mv, p) and released(pl, p))

fact capture_is_move :
  forall c : Capture .
    c isa Move

fact piece_owner_exists :
  forall p : Piece .
    exists pl : Player . piece_owner(p, pl)

fact move_directions_exist :
  forall mv : Move .
    move_direction(mv, Forward) or move_direction(mv, Backward)

fact move_hand_used :
  forall mv : Move .
    move_hand(mv, OneHand) or move_hand(mv, TwoHands)

fact capture_victims :
  forall c : Capture .
    exists p : Piece . capture_victim(c, p)

fact capture_chains :
  forall mc : MultipleCapture .
    exists c : Capture . capture_chain(mc, c)

fact capture_hands :
  forall c : Capture .
    capture_hand(c, OneHand) or capture_hand(c, TwoHands)

fact game_turns :
  forall pl : Player .
    game_turn(pl) or not game_turn(pl)

fact touches_relation :
  forall pl : Player, p : Piece .
    touches(pl, p) or not touches(pl, p)

fact playable_pieces :
  forall p : Piece, pl : Player .
    is_playable(p, pl) or not is_playable(p, pl)

fact legal_moves :
  forall mv : Move .
    is_legal_move(mv) or not is_legal_move(mv)

fact legal_captures :
  forall c : Capture .
    is_legal_capture(c) or not is_legal_capture(c)

fact empty_squares :
  forall s : BoardSquare .
    is_empty(s) or not is_empty(s)

fact reaches_last_row_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    reaches_last_row(p) or not reaches_last_row(p)

fact crowned_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    crowned(p) or not crowned(p)

fact meets_diagonally_fact :
  forall p1 : Piece, p2 : Piece .
    meets_diagonally(p1, p2) or not meets_diagonally(p1, p2)

fact has_further_capture_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    has_further_capture(p) or not has_further_capture(p)

fact is_capturing_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    is_capturing(p) or not is_capturing(p)

fact announces_fact :
  forall pl : Player, s : String .
    announces(pl, s) or not announces(pl, s)

fact competition_regulations :
  forall s : String .
    competition_regulations_permit(s) or not competition_regulations_permit(s)

fact captured_in_current_move :
  forall p : Piece .
    is_captured_in_current_move(p) or not is_captured_in_current_move(p)

fact board_placed :
  forall b : Board, p1 : Player, p2 : Player .
    board_placed_between(b, p1, p2) or not board_placed_between(b, p1, p2)

fact long_diagonal_left :
  forall b : Board, p : Player .
    long_diagonal_starts_at_left(b, p) or not long_diagonal_starts_at_left(b, p)

fact legal_square :
  forall p : Piece, s : BoardSquare .
    is_legal_square_for(p, s) or not is_legal_square_for(p, s)

fact count_captures :
  forall mc : MultipleCapture, p : Piece .
    count_captures_of(mc, p) >= 0

fact count_passes_fact :
  forall mc : MultipleCapture, s : BoardSquare .
    count_passes(mc, s) >= 0

fact opponent_of_fact :
  forall pl : Player .
    opponent_of(pl) != pl

fact is_part_of_fact :
  forall mc : MultipleCapture, c : Capture .
    is_part_of(mc, c) or not is_part_of(mc, c)

fact capture_move_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    exists c : Capture . capture_move(p) = c

fact behind_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    exists s : BoardSquare . behind(p) = s

fact exists_empty_behind_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    exists_empty_behind(p) or not exists_empty_behind(p)

fact reaches_last_row_during_capture_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    reaches_last_row_during_capture(p) or not reaches_last_row_during_capture(p)

fact has_opportunity :
  forall p : Piece .
    has_opportunity_to_continue(p) or not has_opportunity_to_continue(p)

fact can_capture_as_king_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    can_capture_as_king(p) or not can_capture_as_king(p)

fact released_fact :
  forall pl : Player, p : Piece .
    released(pl, p) or not released(pl, p)

fact count_captured :
  forall c : Capture .
    count_captured_pieces(c) >= 0

fact capture_of_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    exists c : Capture . capture_of(p) = c

fact next_row_defined :
  forall r : BoardRow .
    exists r2 : BoardRow . next_row(r) = r2

fact row_numbers_defined :
  forall r : BoardRow .
    row_number(r) >= 1 and row_number(r) <= 8

fact move_execution_class_wiring :
  exists pl : Player, mv : Move .
    move_execution_agent(MoveExecutionClass, pl) and
    move_execution_hand(MoveExecutionClass, OneHand) and
    move_execution_move(MoveExecutionClass, mv)

fact board_placement_class_wiring :
  exists pl : Player, b : Board .
    board_placement_agent(BoardPlacementClass, pl) and
    board_placement_target(BoardPlacementClass, b)

// --- DEONTICDECL OBLIGATIONS ---

obligation board_placement :
  forall p1 : Player, p2 : Player, b : Board .
    action: place_board(b)
    scope: BoardPlacementClass
    condition:
      board_placement_agent(BoardPlacementClass, p1) and
      board_placement_agent(BoardPlacementClass, p2) and
      board_placement_target(BoardPlacementClass, b) implies
      (long_diagonal_starts_at_left(b, p1) and long_diagonal_starts_at_left(b, p2))

obligation one_hand_per_move :
  forall mv : Move .
    action: execute_move(mv)
    scope: MoveExecutionClass
    condition:
      move_execution_move(MoveExecutionClass, mv) implies move_hand(mv, OneHand)

obligation man_move_forward :
  forall m : Man, mv : Move .
    action: move_piece(mv, m)
    condition:
      move_direction(mv, Forward) and
      exists s_to : BoardSquare .
        is_empty(s_to) and
        exists s_from : BoardSquare .
          piece_square(m, s_from) and
          square_diagonal(s_from, s_to) and
          square_row(s_to) = next_row(square_row(s_from))

obligation crown_promoted_man :
  forall m : Man .
    action: crown(m)
    condition: reaches_last_row(m) and not crowned(m)

obligation touch_move :
  forall pl : Player, p : Piece, mv : Move .
    action: play_piece(p)
    condition:
      game_turn(pl) and touches(pl, p) and is_playable(p, pl) and
      is_legal_move(mv) and move_piece(mv, p)
    implies
      move_player(mv, pl)

obligation man_capture :
  forall m : Man, opp : Piece .
    action: capture_piece(m, opp)
    condition:
      meets_diagonally(m, opp) and
      exists s_behind : BoardSquare .
        is_empty(s_behind) and
        exists s_from : BoardSquare, s_opp : BoardSquare .
          piece_square(m, s_from) and piece_square(opp, s_opp) and
          square_diagonal(s_from, s_opp) and
          square_diagonal(s_opp, s_behind)

obligation king_capture :
  forall k : King, opp : Piece .
    action: capture_piece(k, opp)
    condition:
      exists d : Diagonal .
        exists s_k : BoardSquare, s_opp : BoardSquare .
          piece_square(k, s_k) and piece_square(opp, s_opp) and
          square_diagonal(s_k, d) and square_diagonal(s_opp, d) and
          exists_empty_behind(opp)

obligation capture_indication :
  forall c : Capture .
    action: indicate_capture(c)
    condition: true

obligation capture_one_hand :
  forall c : Capture .
    action: execute_capture(c)
    condition: capture_hand(c, OneHand)

obligation man_multiple_capture :
  forall m : Man, mc : MultipleCapture, opp : Piece .
    action: continue_capture(mc)
    condition:
      meets_diagonally(m, opp) and is_empty(behind(opp))
    implies
      capture_chain(mc, capture_of(opp))

obligation king_multiple_capture :
  forall k : King, mc : MultipleCapture, opp : Piece .
    action: continue_capture(mc)
    condition:
      exists d : Diagonal .
        exists s_k : BoardSquare, s_opp : BoardSquare .
          piece_square(k, s_k) and piece_square(opp, s_opp) and
          square_diagonal(s_k, d) and square_diagonal(s_opp, d) and
          exists_empty_behind(opp)
    implies
      capture_chain(mc, capture_of(opp))

obligation continue_capture_promoted :
  forall m : Man, mc : MultipleCapture .
    action: continue_capture_as_king(mc)
    condition:
      reaches_last_row_during_capture(m) and has_further_capture(m)

obligation man_becomes_king :
  forall m : Man .
    action: crown(m)
    condition: reaches_last_row(m) and not is_capturing(m)

obligation announce_adjustment :
  forall pl : Player .
    action: adjust_pieces(pl)
    condition: announces(pl, "I adjust") or announces(pl, "corrected")

// --- DEONTICDECL PROHIBITIONS ---

prohibition self_capture :
  forall pl : Player, p : Piece .
    action: capture(p)
    condition: piece_owner(p, pl)

prohibition jump_own_piece :
  forall p : Piece, mc : MultipleCapture .
    action: jump_over(p)
    condition: true

prohibition repeat_opponent_capture :
  forall opp : Piece, mc : MultipleCapture .
    action: jump_over(opp)
    condition: count_captures_of(mc, opp) > 1

prohibition touch_opponent_pieces :
  forall pl : Player, opp_p : Piece .
    action: touch(opp_p)
    condition: not game_turn(pl)

prohibition two_hands_capture :
  forall c : Capture .
    action: execute_capture(c)
    condition: capture_hand(c, TwoHands)

// --- DEONTICDECL PERMISSIONS ---

permission choice_capture :
  forall pl : Player .
    action: choose_capture_direction
    condition:
      exists c1 : Capture, c2 : Capture .
        is_legal_capture(c1) and is_legal_capture(c2) and
        c1 != c2

permission repeat_empty_square :

{"ir_text": "// ============================================================
// IDF Official Rules of Draughts-64 — rules_core
// Sections 2 (The material), 3 (Movement), 4 (Capture)
// ============================================================

// --- SORTS ---

sort BoardSquare
sort BoardRow
sort BoardColumn
sort Diagonal
sort Board

sort Piece
sort Man < Piece
sort King < Piece
sort PieceColor = White | Black

sort Move
sort Capture < Move
sort MultipleCapture < Capture

sort MoveDirection = Forward | Backward

sort Player
sort Hand = OneHand | TwoHands

sort MoveExecution
sort BoardPlacement

// --- ENTITIES ---

entity MoveExecutionClass : MoveExecution
entity BoardPlacementClass : BoardPlacement

// --- RELATIONS ---

rel square_row : BoardSquare, BoardRow
rel square_column : BoardSquare, BoardColumn
rel square_is_dark : BoardSquare
rel square_diagonal : BoardSquare, Diagonal

rel piece_color : Piece, PieceColor
rel piece_square : Piece, BoardSquare
rel piece_owner : Piece, Player

rel move_piece : Move, Piece
rel move_player : Move, Player
rel move_direction : Move, MoveDirection
rel move_hand : Move, Hand
rel move_is_complete : Move

rel capture_victim : Capture, Piece
rel capture_chain : MultipleCapture, Capture
rel capture_hand : Capture, Hand

rel game_turn : Player
rel touches : Player, Piece
rel is_playable : Piece, Player
rel is_legal_move : Move
rel is_legal_capture : Capture
rel is_empty : BoardSquare
rel reaches_last_row : Piece
rel crowned : Piece
rel promoted_from : King, Man
rel can_move_direction : Piece, MoveDirection
rel meets_diagonally : Piece, Piece
rel has_further_capture : Piece
rel is_capturing : Piece
rel announces : Player, String
rel competition_regulations_permit : String
rel is_captured_in_current_move : Piece
rel count_pieces_of_color : PieceColor -> Integer
rel rows_1_to_3 : BoardRow
rel rows_6_to_8 : BoardRow
rel row_number : BoardRow -> Integer
rel diagonal_length : Diagonal, Integer
rel board_placed_between : Board, Player, Player
rel long_diagonal_starts_at_left : Board, Player
rel board_has_bases : Board
rel board_has_sides : Board
rel board_has_rows : Board
rel board_has_columns : Board
rel next_row : BoardRow -> BoardRow
rel is_legal_square_for : Piece, BoardSquare
rel count_captures_of : MultipleCapture, Piece -> Integer
rel count_passes : MultipleCapture, BoardSquare -> Integer
rel opponent_of : Player -> Player
rel first_player : Player
rel movement_type : Piece -> String
rel is_part_of : MultipleCapture, Capture
rel capture_move : Piece -> Capture
rel behind : Piece -> BoardSquare
rel exists_empty_behind : Piece
rel reaches_last_row_during_capture : Piece
rel has_opportunity_to_continue : Piece
rel can_capture_as_king : Piece
rel released : Player, Piece
rel count_captured_pieces : Capture -> Integer
rel capture_of : Piece -> Capture

rel move_execution_agent : MoveExecution, Player
rel move_execution_hand : MoveExecution, Hand
rel move_execution_move : MoveExecution, Move

rel board_placement_agent : BoardPlacement, Player
rel board_placement_target : BoardPlacement, Board

// --- ASSERTDECL FACTS ---

fact board_squares_alternate :
  forall s : BoardSquare . square_is_dark(s) or not square_is_dark(s)

fact dark_squares_are_active :
  forall s : BoardSquare . square_is_dark(s)

fact diagonals_are_skewed :
  forall s1 : BoardSquare, s2 : BoardSquare, d : Diagonal .
    (square_diagonal(s1, d) and square_diagonal(s2, d)) implies
    (square_row(s1) != square_row(s2) and square_column(s1) != square_column(s2))

fact long_diagonal_has_eight :
  exists d : Diagonal . diagonal_length(d, 8)

fact board_features :
  forall b : Board .
    board_has_bases(b) and board_has_sides(b) and board_has_rows(b) and board_has_columns(b)

fact twelve_white :
  count_pieces_of_color(White) = 12

fact twelve_black :
  count_pieces_of_color(Black) = 12

fact white_on_rows_1_to_3 :
  forall p : Piece .
    piece_color(p, White) implies
    (exists r : BoardRow . rows_1_to_3(r) and
     exists s : BoardSquare . piece_square(p, s) and square_row(s, r))

fact black_on_rows_6_to_8 :
  forall p : Piece .
    piece_color(p, Black) implies
    (exists r : BoardRow . rows_6_to_8(r) and
     exists s : BoardSquare . piece_square(p, s) and square_row(s, r))

fact rows_4_5_empty :
  forall s : BoardSquare .
    (exists r : BoardRow . square_row(s, r) and
     (row_number(r) = 4 or row_number(r) = 5)) implies
    not exists p : Piece . piece_square(p, s)

fact piece_is_man_or_king :
  forall p : Piece .
    (p isa Man) or (p isa King)

fact different_movement :
  forall m : Man, k : King .
    movement_type(m) != movement_type(k)

fact first_move_white :
  forall pl : Player .
    first_player(pl) implies
    exists p : Piece . piece_owner(p, pl) and piece_color(p, White)

fact king_is_crowned_man :
  forall m : Man, k : King .
    (reaches_last_row(m) and crowned(m)) implies
    (k isa King and promoted_from(k, m))

fact king_moves_both :
  forall k : King .
    can_move_direction(k, Forward) and can_move_direction(k, Backward)

fact move_finished_on_release :
  forall mv : Move .
    move_is_complete(mv) implies
    (exists pl : Player, p : Piece .
      move_player(mv, pl) and move_piece(mv, p) and released(pl, p))

fact capture_is_move :
  forall c : Capture .
    c isa Move

fact piece_owner_exists :
  forall p : Piece .
    exists pl : Player . piece_owner(p, pl)

fact move_directions_exist :
  forall mv : Move .
    move_direction(mv, Forward) or move_direction(mv, Backward)

fact move_hand_used :
  forall mv : Move .
    move_hand(mv, OneHand) or move_hand(mv, TwoHands)

fact capture_victims :
  forall c : Capture .
    exists p : Piece . capture_victim(c, p)

fact capture_chains :
  forall mc : MultipleCapture .
    exists c : Capture . capture_chain(mc, c)

fact capture_hands :
  forall c : Capture .
    capture_hand(c, OneHand) or capture_hand(c, TwoHands)

fact game_turns :
  forall pl : Player .
    game_turn(pl) or not game_turn(pl)

fact touches_relation :
  forall pl : Player, p : Piece .
    touches(pl, p) or not touches(pl, p)

fact playable_pieces :
  forall p : Piece, pl : Player .
    is_playable(p, pl) or not is_playable(p, pl)

fact legal_moves :
  forall mv : Move .
    is_legal_move(mv) or not is_legal_move(mv)

fact legal_captures :
  forall c : Capture .
    is_legal_capture(c) or not is_legal_capture(c)

fact empty_squares :
  forall s : BoardSquare .
    is_empty(s) or not is_empty(s)

fact reaches_last_row_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    reaches_last_row(p) or not reaches_last_row(p)

fact crowned_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    crowned(p) or not crowned(p)

fact meets_diagonally_fact :
  forall p1 : Piece, p2 : Piece .
    meets_diagonally(p1, p2) or not meets_diagonally(p1, p2)

fact has_further_capture_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    has_further_capture(p) or not has_further_capture(p)

fact is_capturing_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    is_capturing(p) or not is_capturing(p)

fact announces_fact :
  forall pl : Player, s : String .
    announces(pl, s) or not announces(pl, s)

fact competition_regulations :
  forall s : String .
    competition_regulations_permit(s) or not competition_regulations_permit(s)

fact captured_in_current_move :
  forall p : Piece .
    is_captured_in_current_move(p) or not is_captured_in_current_move(p)

fact board_placed :
  forall b : Board, p1 : Player, p2 : Player .
    board_placed_between(b, p1, p2) or not board_placed_between(b, p1, p2)

fact long_diagonal_left :
  forall b : Board, p : Player .
    long_diagonal_starts_at_left(b, p) or not long_diagonal_starts_at_left(b, p)

fact legal_square :
  forall p : Piece, s : BoardSquare .
    is_legal_square_for(p, s) or not is_legal_square_for(p, s)

fact count_captures :
  forall mc : MultipleCapture, p : Piece .
    count_captures_of(mc, p) >= 0

fact count_passes_fact :
  forall mc : MultipleCapture, s : BoardSquare .
    count_passes(mc, s) >= 0

fact opponent_of_fact :
  forall pl : Player .
    opponent_of(pl) != pl

fact is_part_of_fact :
  forall mc : MultipleCapture, c : Capture .
    is_part_of(mc, c) or not is_part_of(mc, c)

fact capture_move_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    exists c : Capture . capture_move(p) = c

fact behind_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    exists s : BoardSquare . behind(p) = s

fact exists_empty_behind_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    exists_empty_behind(p) or not exists_empty_behind(p)

fact reaches_last_row_during_capture_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    reaches_last_row_during_capture(p) or not reaches_last_row_during_capture(p)

fact has_opportunity :
  forall p : Piece .
    has_opportunity_to_continue(p) or not has_opportunity_to_continue(p)

fact can_capture_as_king_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    can_capture_as_king(p) or not can_capture_as_king(p)

fact released_fact :
  forall pl : Player, p : Piece .
    released(pl, p) or not released(pl, p)

fact count_captured :
  forall c : Capture .
    count_captured_pieces(c) >= 0

fact capture_of_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    exists c : Capture . capture_of(p) = c

fact next_row_defined :
  forall r : BoardRow .
    exists r2 : BoardRow . next_row(r) = r2

fact row_numbers_defined :
  forall r : BoardRow .
    row_number(r) >= 1 and row_number(r) <= 8

fact move_execution_class_wiring :
  exists pl : Player, mv : Move .
    move_execution_agent(MoveExecutionClass, pl) and
    move_execution_hand(MoveExecutionClass, OneHand) and
    move_execution_move(MoveExecutionClass, mv)

fact board_placement_class_wiring :
  exists pl : Player, b : Board .
    board_placement_agent(BoardPlacementClass, pl) and
    board_placement_target(BoardPlacementClass, b)

// --- DEONTICDECL OBLIGATIONS ---

obligation board_placement :
  forall p1 : Player, p2 : Player, b : Board .
    action: place_board(b)
    scope: BoardPlacementClass
    condition:
      board_placement_agent(BoardPlacementClass, p1) and
      board_placement_agent(BoardPlacementClass, p2) and
      board_placement_target(BoardPlacementClass, b) implies
      (long_diagonal_starts_at_left(b, p1) and long_diagonal_starts_at_left(b, p2))

obligation one_hand_per_move :
  forall mv : Move .
    action: execute_move(mv)
    scope: MoveExecutionClass
    condition:
      move_execution_move(MoveExecutionClass, mv) implies move_hand(mv, OneHand)

obligation man_move_forward :
  forall m : Man, mv : Move .
    action: move_piece(mv, m)
    condition:
      move_direction(mv, Forward) and
      exists s_to : BoardSquare .
        is_empty(s_to) and
        exists s_from : BoardSquare .
          piece_square(m, s_from) and
          square_diagonal(s_from, s_to) and
          square_row(s_to) = next_row(square_row(s_from))

obligation crown_promoted_man :
  forall m : Man .
    action: crown(m)
    condition: reaches_last_row(m) and not crowned(m)

obligation touch_move :
  forall pl : Player, p : Piece, mv : Move .
    action: play_piece(p)
    condition:
      game_turn(pl) and touches(pl, p) and is_playable(p, pl) and
      is_legal_move(mv) and move_piece(mv, p)
    implies
      move_player(mv, pl)

obligation man_capture :
  forall m : Man, opp : Piece .
    action: capture_piece(m, opp)
    condition:
      meets_diagonally(m, opp) and
      exists s_behind : BoardSquare .
        is_empty(s_behind) and
        exists s_from : BoardSquare, s_opp : BoardSquare .
          piece_square(m, s_from) and piece_square(opp, s_opp) and
          square_diagonal(s_from, s_opp) and
          square_diagonal(s_opp, s_behind)

obligation king_capture :
  forall k : King, opp : Piece .
    action: capture_piece(k, opp)
    condition:
      exists d : Diagonal .
        exists s_k : BoardSquare, s_opp : BoardSquare .
          piece_square(k, s_k) and piece_square(opp, s_opp) and
          square_diagonal(s_k, d) and square_diagonal(s_opp, d) and
          exists_empty_behind(opp)

obligation capture_indication :
  forall c : Capture .
    action: indicate_capture(c)
    condition: true

obligation capture_one_hand :
  forall c : Capture .
    action: execute_capture(c)
    condition: capture_hand(c, OneHand)

obligation man_multiple_capture :
  forall m : Man, mc : MultipleCapture, opp : Piece .
    action: continue_capture(mc)
    condition:
      meets_diagonally(m, opp) and is_empty(behind(opp))
    implies
      capture_chain(mc, capture_of(opp))

obligation king_multiple_capture :
  forall k : King, mc : MultipleCapture, opp : Piece .
    action: continue_capture(mc)
    condition:
      exists d : Diagonal .
        exists s_k : BoardSquare, s_opp : BoardSquare .
          piece_square(k, s_k) and piece_square(opp, s_opp) and
          square_diagonal(s_k, d) and square_diagonal(s_opp, d) and
          exists_empty_behind(opp)
    implies
      capture_chain(mc, capture_of(opp))

obligation continue_capture_promoted :
  forall m : Man, mc : MultipleCapture .
    action: continue_capture_as_king(mc)
    condition:
      reaches_last_row_during_capture(m) and has_further_capture(m)

obligation man_becomes_king :
  forall m : Man .
    action: crown(m)
    condition: reaches_last_row(m) and not is_capturing(m)

obligation announce_adjustment :
  forall pl : Player .
    action: adjust_pieces(pl)
    condition: announces(pl, "I adjust") or announces(pl, "corrected")

// --- DEONTICDECL PROHIBITIONS ---

prohibition self_capture :
  forall pl : Player, p : Piece .
    action: capture(p)
    condition: piece_owner(p, pl)

prohibition jump_own_piece :
  forall p : Piece, mc : MultipleCapture .
    action: jump_over(p)
    condition: true

prohibition repeat_opponent_capture :
  forall opp : Piece, mc : MultipleCapture .
    action: jump_over(opp)
    condition: count_captures_of(mc, opp) > 1

prohibition touch_opponent_pieces :
  forall pl : Player, opp_p : Piece .
    action: touch(opp_p)
    condition: not game_turn(pl)

prohibition two_hands_capture :
  forall c : Capture .
    action: execute_capture(c)
    condition: capture_hand(c, TwoHands)

// --- DEONTICDECL PERMISSIONS ---

permission choice_capture :
  forall pl : Player .
    action: choose_capture_direction
    condition:
      exists c1 : Capture, c2 : Capture .
        is_legal_capture(c1) and is_legal_capture(c2) and
        c1 != c2

permission repeat_empty_square :
  forall s : BoardSquare, mc : MultipleCapture .
    action: pass_over(s)
    condition: is_empty(s)

permission adjust_before_release :
  forall pl : Player, p : Piece, mv : Move .
    action: change_square(p)
    condition:
      not move_is_complete(mv) and
      move_piece(mv, p) and
      exists s : BoardSquare . is_empty(s) and is_legal_square_for(p, s)

permission king_denotation :
  forall k : King .
    action: denote_king(k)
    condition: competition_regulations_permit("inversion_of_man")

permission king_choice_square :
  forall k : King, s : BoardSquare .
    action: occupy(s)
    condition:
      is_empty(s) and
      exists opp : Piece .
        is_captured_in_current_move(opp) and
        exists d : Diagonal .
          square_diagonal(s, d) and
          exists s_k : BoardSquare .
            piece_square(k, s_k) and square_diagonal(s_k, d)

permission brazilian_choice_capture :
  forall pl : Player .
    action: choose_any_piece_for_max_capture
    condition:
      exists c1 : Capture, c2 : Capture .
        is_legal_capture(c1) and is_legal_capture(c2) and
        c1 != c2 and
        count_captured_pieces(c1) = count_captured_pieces(c2)

permission brazilian_man_continues_as_man :
  forall m : Man, mc : MultipleCapture .
    action: continue_capture_as_man(mc)
    condition:
      reaches_last_row_during_capture(m) and has_opportunity_to_continue(m)

permission brazilian_man_becomes_king_next_move :
  forall m : Man .
    action: become_king_and_capture_next(m)
    condition:
      reaches_last_row_during_capture(m) and can_capture_as_king(m)
"}

{"ir_text": "// ============================================================
// IDF Official Rules of Draughts-64 — rules_core
// Sections 2 (The material), 3 (Movement), 4 (Capture)
// ============================================================

// --- SORTS ---

sort BoardSquare
sort BoardRow
sort BoardColumn
sort Diagonal
sort Board

sort Piece
sort Man < Piece
sort King < Piece
sort PieceColor = White | Black

sort Move
sort Capture < Move
sort MultipleCapture < Capture

sort MoveDirection = Forward | Backward

sort Player
sort Hand = OneHand | TwoHands

sort MoveExecution
sort BoardPlacement

// --- ENTITIES ---

entity MoveExecutionClass : MoveExecution
entity BoardPlacementClass : BoardPlacement

// --- RELATIONS ---

rel square_row : BoardSquare, BoardRow
rel square_column : BoardSquare, BoardColumn
rel square_is_dark : BoardSquare
rel square_diagonal : BoardSquare, Diagonal

rel piece_color : Piece, PieceColor
rel piece_square : Piece, BoardSquare
rel piece_owner : Piece, Player

rel move_piece : Move, Piece
rel move_player : Move, Player
rel move_direction : Move, MoveDirection
rel move_hand : Move, Hand
rel move_is_complete : Move

rel capture_victim : Capture, Piece
rel capture_chain : MultipleCapture, Capture
rel capture_hand : Capture, Hand

rel game_turn : Player
rel touches : Player, Piece
rel is_playable : Piece, Player
rel is_legal_move : Move
rel is_legal_capture : Capture
rel is_empty : BoardSquare
rel reaches_last_row : Piece
rel crowned : Piece
rel promoted_from : King, Man
rel can_move_direction : Piece, MoveDirection
rel meets_diagonally : Piece, Piece
rel has_further_capture : Piece
rel is_capturing : Piece
rel announces : Player, String
rel competition_regulations_permit : String
rel is_captured_in_current_move : Piece
rel count_pieces_of_color : PieceColor -> Integer
rel rows_1_to_3 : BoardRow
rel rows_6_to_8 : BoardRow
rel row_number : BoardRow -> Integer
rel diagonal_length : Diagonal, Integer
rel board_placed_between : Board, Player, Player
rel long_diagonal_starts_at_left : Board, Player
rel board_has_bases : Board
rel board_has_sides : Board
rel board_has_rows : Board
rel board_has_columns : Board
rel next_row : BoardRow -> BoardRow
rel is_legal_square_for : Piece, BoardSquare
rel count_captures_of : MultipleCapture, Piece -> Integer
rel count_passes : MultipleCapture, BoardSquare -> Integer
rel opponent_of : Player -> Player
rel first_player : Player
rel movement_type : Piece -> String
rel is_part_of : MultipleCapture, Capture
rel capture_move : Piece -> Capture
rel behind : Piece -> BoardSquare
rel exists_empty_behind : Piece
rel reaches_last_row_during_capture : Piece
rel has_opportunity_to_continue : Piece
rel can_capture_as_king : Piece
rel released : Player, Piece
rel count_captured_pieces : Capture -> Integer
rel capture_of : Piece -> Capture

rel move_execution_agent : MoveExecution, Player
rel move_execution_hand : MoveExecution, Hand
rel move_execution_move : MoveExecution, Move

rel board_placement_agent : BoardPlacement, Player
rel board_placement_target : BoardPlacement, Board

// --- ASSERTDECL FACTS ---

fact board_squares_alternate :
  forall s : BoardSquare . square_is_dark(s) or not square_is_dark(s)

fact dark_squares_are_active :
  forall s : BoardSquare . square_is_dark(s)

fact diagonals_are_skewed :
  forall s1 : BoardSquare, s2 : BoardSquare, d : Diagonal .
    (square_diagonal(s1, d) and square_diagonal(s2, d)) implies
    (square_row(s1) != square_row(s2) and square_column(s1) != square_column(s2))

fact long_diagonal_has_eight :
  exists d : Diagonal . diagonal_length(d, 8)

fact board_features :
  forall b : Board .
    board_has_bases(b) and board_has_sides(b) and board_has_rows(b) and board_has_columns(b)

fact twelve_white :
  count_pieces_of_color(White) = 12

fact twelve_black :
  count_pieces_of_color(Black) = 12

fact white_on_rows_1_to_3 :
  forall p : Piece .
    piece_color(p, White) implies
    (exists r : BoardRow . rows_1_to_3(r) and
     exists s : BoardSquare . piece_square(p, s) and square_row(s, r))

fact black_on_rows_6_to_8 :
  forall p : Piece .
    piece_color(p, Black) implies
    (exists r : BoardRow . rows_6_to_8(r) and
     exists s : BoardSquare . piece_square(p, s) and square_row(s, r))

fact rows_4_5_empty :
  forall s : BoardSquare .
    (exists r : BoardRow . square_row(s, r) and
     (row_number(r) = 4 or row_number(r) = 5)) implies
    not exists p : Piece . piece_square(p, s)

fact piece_is_man_or_king :
  forall p : Piece .
    (p isa Man) or (p isa King)

fact different_movement :
  forall m : Man, k : King .
    movement_type(m) != movement_type(k)

fact first_move_white :
  forall pl : Player .
    first_player(pl) implies
    exists p : Piece . piece_owner(p, pl) and piece_color(p, White)

fact king_is_crowned_man :
  forall m : Man, k : King .
    (reaches_last_row(m) and crowned(m)) implies
    (k isa King and promoted_from(k, m))

fact king_moves_both :
  forall k : King .
    can_move_direction(k, Forward) and can_move_direction(k, Backward)

fact move_finished_on_release :
  forall mv : Move .
    move_is_complete(mv) implies
    (exists pl : Player, p : Piece .
      move_player(mv, pl) and move_piece(mv, p) and released(pl, p))

fact capture_is_move :
  forall c : Capture .
    c isa Move

fact piece_owner_exists :
  forall p : Piece .
    exists pl : Player . piece_owner(p, pl)

fact move_directions_exist :
  forall mv : Move .
    move_direction(mv, Forward) or move_direction(mv, Backward)

fact move_hand_used :
  forall mv : Move .
    move_hand(mv, OneHand) or move_hand(mv, TwoHands)

fact capture_victims :
  forall c : Capture .
    exists p : Piece . capture_victim(c, p)

fact capture_chains :
  forall mc : MultipleCapture .
    exists c : Capture . capture_chain(mc, c)

fact capture_hands :
  forall c : Capture .
    capture_hand(c, OneHand) or capture_hand(c, TwoHands)

fact game_turns :
  forall pl : Player .
    game_turn(pl) or not game_turn(pl)

fact touches_relation :
  forall pl : Player, p : Piece .
    touches(pl, p) or not touches(pl, p)

fact playable_pieces :
  forall p : Piece, pl : Player .
    is_playable(p, pl) or not is_playable(p, pl)

fact legal_moves :
  forall mv : Move .
    is_legal_move(mv) or not is_legal_move(mv)

fact legal_captures :
  forall c : Capture .
    is_legal_capture(c) or not is_legal_capture(c)

fact empty_squares :
  forall s : BoardSquare .
    is_empty(s) or not is_empty(s)

fact reaches_last_row_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    reaches_last_row(p) or not reaches_last_row(p)

fact crowned_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    crowned(p) or not crowned(p)

fact meets_diagonally_fact :
  forall p1 : Piece, p2 : Piece .
    meets_diagonally(p1, p2) or not meets_diagonally(p1, p2)

fact has_further_capture_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    has_further_capture(p) or not has_further_capture(p)

fact is_capturing_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    is_capturing(p) or not is_capturing(p)

fact announces_fact :
  forall pl : Player, s : String .
    announces(pl, s) or not announces(pl, s)

fact competition_regulations :
  forall s : String .
    competition_regulations_permit(s) or not competition_regulations_permit(s)

fact captured_in_current_move :
  forall p : Piece .
    is_captured_in_current_move(p) or not is_captured_in_current_move(p)

fact board_placed :
  forall b : Board, p1 : Player, p2 : Player .
    board_placed_between(b, p1, p2) or not board_placed_between(b, p1, p2)

fact long_diagonal_left :
  forall b : Board, p : Player .
    long_diagonal_starts_at_left(b, p) or not long_diagonal_starts_at_left(b, p)

fact legal_square :
  forall p : Piece, s : BoardSquare .
    is_legal_square_for(p, s) or not is_legal_square_for(p, s)

fact count_captures :
  forall mc : MultipleCapture, p : Piece .
    count_captures_of(mc, p) >= 0

fact count_passes_fact :
  forall mc : MultipleCapture, s : BoardSquare .
    count_passes(mc, s) >= 0

fact opponent_of_fact :
  forall pl : Player .
    opponent_of(pl) != pl

fact is_part_of_fact :
  forall mc : MultipleCapture, c : Capture .
    is_part_of(mc, c) or not is_part_of(mc, c)

fact capture_move_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    exists c : Capture . capture_move(p) = c

fact behind_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    exists s : BoardSquare . behind(p) = s

fact exists_empty_behind_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    exists_empty_behind(p) or not exists_empty_behind(p)

fact reaches_last_row_during_capture_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    reaches_last_row_during_capture(p) or not reaches_last_row_during_capture(p)

fact has_opportunity :
  forall p : Piece .
    has_opportunity_to_continue(p) or not has_opportunity_to_continue(p)

fact can_capture_as_king_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    can_capture_as_king(p) or not can_capture_as_king(p)

fact released_fact :
  forall pl : Player, p : Piece .
    released(pl, p) or not released(pl, p)

fact count_captured :
  forall c : Capture .
    count_captured_pieces(c) >= 0

fact capture_of_fact :
  forall p : Piece .
    exists c : Capture . capture_of(p) = c

fact next_row_defined :
  forall r : BoardRow .
    exists r2 : BoardRow . next_row(r) = r2

fact row_numbers_defined :
  forall r : BoardRow .
    row_number(r) >= 1 and row_number(r) <= 8

fact move_execution_class_wiring :
  exists pl : Player, mv : Move .
    move_execution_agent(MoveExecutionClass, pl) and
    move_execution_hand(MoveExecutionClass, OneHand) and
    move_execution_move(MoveExecutionClass, mv)

fact board_placement_class_wiring :
  exists pl : Player, b : Board .
    board_placement_agent(BoardPlacementClass, pl) and
    board_placement_target(BoardPlacementClass, b)

// --- DEONTICDECL OBLIGATIONS ---

obligation board_placement :
  forall p1 : Player, p2 : Player, b : Board .
    action: place_board(b)
    scope: BoardPlacementClass
    condition:
      board_placement_agent(BoardPlacementClass, p1) and
      board_placement_agent(BoardPlacementClass, p2) and
      board_placement_target(BoardPlacementClass, b) implies
      (long_diagonal_starts_at_left(b, p1) and long_diagonal_starts_at_left(b, p2))

obligation one_hand_per_move :
  forall mv : Move .
    action: execute_move(mv)
    scope: MoveExecutionClass
    condition:
      move_execution_move(MoveExecutionClass, mv) implies move_hand(mv, OneHand)

obligation man_move_forward :
  forall m : Man, mv : Move .
    action: move_piece(mv, m)
    condition:
      move_direction(mv, Forward) and
      exists s_to : BoardSquare .
        is_empty(s_to) and
        exists s_from : BoardSquare .
          piece_square(m, s_from) and
          square_diagonal(s_from, s_to) and
          square_row(s_to) = next_row(square_row(s_from))

obligation crown_promoted_man :
  forall m : Man .
    action: crown(m)
    condition: reaches_last_row(m) and not crowned(m)

obligation touch_move :
  forall pl : Player, p : Piece, mv : Move .
    action: play_piece(p)
    condition:
      game_turn(pl) and touches(pl, p) and is_playable(p, pl) and
      is_legal_move(mv) and move_piece(mv, p)
    implies
      move_player(mv, pl)

obligation man_capture :
  forall m : Man, opp : Piece .
    action: capture_piece(m, opp)
    condition:
      meets_diagonally(m, opp) and
      exists s_behind : BoardSquare .
        is_empty(s_behind) and
        exists s_from : BoardSquare, s_opp : BoardSquare .
          piece_square(m, s_from) and piece_square(opp, s_opp) and
          square_diagonal(s_from, s_opp) and
          square_diagonal(s_opp, s_behind)

obligation king_capture :
  forall k : King, opp : Piece .
    action: capture_piece(k, opp)
    condition:
      exists d : Diagonal .
        exists s_k : BoardSquare, s_opp : BoardSquare .
          piece_square(k, s_k) and piece_square(opp, s_opp) and
          square_diagonal(s_k, d) and square_diagonal(s_opp, d) and
          exists_empty_behind(opp)

obligation capture_indication :
  forall c : Capture .
    action: indicate_capture(c)
    condition: true

obligation capture_one_hand :
  forall c : Capture .
    action: execute_capture(c)
    condition: capture_hand(c, OneHand)

obligation man_multiple_capture :
  forall m : Man, mc : MultipleCapture, opp : Piece .
    action: continue_capture(mc)
    condition:
      meets_diagonally(m, opp) and is_empty(behind(opp))
    implies
      capture_chain(mc, capture_of(opp))

obligation king_multiple_capture :
  forall k : King, mc : MultipleCapture, opp : Piece .
    action: continue_capture(mc)
    condition:
      exists d : Diagonal .
        exists s_k : BoardSquare, s_opp : BoardSquare .
          piece_square(k, s_k) and piece_square(opp, s_opp) and
          square_diagonal(s_k, d) and square_diagonal(s_opp, d) and
          exists_empty_behind(opp)
    implies
      capture_chain(mc, capture_of(opp))

obligation continue_capture_promoted :
  forall m : Man, mc : MultipleCapture .
    action: continue_capture_as_king(mc)
    condition:
      reaches_last_row_during_capture(m) and has_further_capture(m)

obligation man_becomes_king :
  forall m : Man .
    action: crown(m)
    condition: reaches_last_row(m) and not is_capturing(m)

obligation announce_adjustment :
  forall pl : Player .
    action: adjust_pieces(pl)
    condition: announces(pl, "I adjust") or announces(pl, "corrected")

// --- DEONTICDECL PROHIBITIONS ---

prohibition self_capture :
  forall pl : Player, p : Piece .
    action: capture(p)
    condition: piece_owner(p, pl)

prohibition jump_own_piece :
  forall p : Piece, mc : MultipleCapture .
    action: jump_over(p)
    condition: true

prohibition repeat_opponent_capture :
  forall opp : Piece, mc : MultipleCapture .
    action: jump_over(opp)
    condition: count_captures_of(mc, opp) > 1

prohibition touch_opponent_pieces :
  forall pl : Player, opp_p : Piece .
    action: touch(opp_p)
    condition: not game_turn(pl)

prohibition two_hands_capture :
  forall c : Capture .
    action: execute_capture(c)
    condition: capture_hand(c, TwoHands)

// --- DEONTICDECL PERMISSIONS ---

permission choice_capture :
  forall pl : Player .
    action: choose_capture_direction
    condition:
      exists c1 : Capture, c2 : Capture .
        is_legal_capture(c1) and is_legal_capture(c2) and
        c1 != c2

permission repeat_empty_square :
  forall s : BoardSquare, mc : MultipleCapture .
    action: pass_over(s)
    condition: is_empty(s)

permission adjust_before_release :
  forall pl : Player, p : Piece, mv : Move .
    action: change_square(p)
    condition:
      not move_is_complete(mv) and
      move_piece(mv, p) and
      exists s : BoardSquare . is_empty(s) and is_legal_square_for(p, s)

permission king_denotation :
  forall k : King .
    action: denote_king(k)
    condition: competition_regulations_permit("inversion_of_man")

permission king_choice_square :
  forall k : King, s : BoardSquare .
    action: occupy(s)
    condition:
      is_empty(s) and
      exists opp : Piece .
        is_captured_in_current_move(opp) and
        exists d : Diagonal .
          square_diagonal(s, d) and
          exists s_k : BoardSquare .
            piece_square(k, s_k) and square_diagonal(s_k, d)

permission brazilian_choice_capture :
  forall pl : Player .
    action: choose_any_piece_for_max_capture
    condition:
      exists c1 : Capture, c2 : Capture .
        is_legal_capture(c1) and is_legal_capture(c2) and
        c1 != c2 and
        count_captured_pieces(c1) = count_captured_pieces(c2)

permission brazilian_man_continues_as_man :
  forall m : Man, mc : MultipleCapture .
    action: continue_capture_as_man(mc)
    condition:
      reaches_last_row_during_capture(m) and has_opportunity_to_continue(m)

permission brazilian_man_becomes_king_next_move :
  forall m : Man .
    action: become_king_and_capture_next(m)
    condition:
      reaches_last_row_during_capture(m) and can_capture_as_king(m)
"}

fact twelve_black :

fact white_on_rows_1_to_3 :
  forall p : Piece .

     exists s : BoardSquare . piece_square(p, s) and square_row(s, r))

fact black_on_rows_6_to_8 :
  forall p : Piece .
    piece_color(p, Black) implies
    (exists r : BoardRow . rows_6_to_8(r) and
     exists s : BoardSquare . piece_square(p, s) and square_row(s, r))

fact rows_4_5_empty :
  forall s : BoardSquare .
    (exists r : BoardRow . square_row(s, r) and
     (row_number(r) = 4 or row_number(r) = 5)) implies
    not exists p : Piece . piece_square(p, s)

fact piece_is_man_or_king :
  forall p : Piece .
    (p isa Man) or (p isa King)

fact different_movement :
  forall m : Man, k : King .
    movement_type(m) != movement_type(k)

fact first_move_white :
  forall pl : Player .
    first_player(pl) implies
    exists p : Piece . piece_owner(p, pl) and piece_color(p, White)

fact king_is_crowned_man :
  forall m : Man, k : King .
    (reaches_last_row(m) and crowned(m)) implies

fact king_moves_both :
  forall k : King .

fact move_finished_on_release :
  forall mv : Move .

    (exists pl : Player, p : Piece .
      move_player(mv, pl) and move_piece(mv, p) and released(pl, p))

fact capture_is_move :
  forall c : Capture .
    c isa Move

fact piece_owner_exists :
  forall p : Piece .
    exists pl : Player . piece_owner(p, pl)

fact move_directions_exist :
  forall mv : Move .
    move_direction(mv, Forward) or move_direction(mv, Backward)

fact move_hand_used :
  forall mv : Move .
    move_hand(mv, OneHand) or move_hand(mv, TwoHands)

fact capture_victims :

    exists p : Piece . capture_victim(c, p)

fact capture_chains :
  forall mc : MultipleCapture .
    exists c : Capture . capture_chain(mc, c)

fact capture_hands :
